correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 16,384 vertex masks using the complement-dominates predicate for the 14-vertex Fano incidence graph, yielding 8,851 augmented faces and the claimed nonempty f-vector. The independently generated deterministic 4,424-pair matching has one critical 0-cell and one critical 6-cell; exhaustive topological sorting of all 52,304 nonempty Hasse incidences visits all 8,850 faces, certifying acyclicity. Forman therefore gives the integral S^6 homotopy model, without inferring integral results from mod-two ranks. The original RESULT.md cross-polytope construction chooses one endpoint per perfect matching edge; its chain join has 128 facets, is a cycle, and evaluates by coefficient of an all-point isolated 6-face to ±1, proving a primitive generator. Point-preserving 168 collineations act with even point permutation and polarity has two compensating signs, so the full 336-element action is +1. Scope only this finite Fano graph.
